water.title: Low concern in reference set
water.explanation: Used primarily as a solvent/carrier in many formulations.

aqua.title: Low concern in reference set
aqua.explanation: Water is commonly used as a solvent/carrier.

glycerin.title: Low concern in reference set
glycerin.explanation: Common humectant used to help retain moisture.

niacinamide.title: Low concern in reference set
niacinamide.explanation: A commonly used cosmetic ingredient with multiple documented formulation functions.

cetearyl alcohol.title: Low concern in reference set
cetearyl alcohol.explanation: A fatty alcohol commonly used as an emollient and consistency aid.

cetyl alcohol.title: Low concern in reference set
cetyl alcohol.explanation: A fatty alcohol commonly used for texture and emolliency.

dimethicone.title: Low concern in reference set
dimethicone.explanation: A silicone used for conditioning and slip in many personal-care formulations.

carbomer.title: Low concern in reference set
carbomer.explanation: A polymer commonly used as a thickener or gelling agent.

sodium benzoate.title: Lower-priority preservative finding
sodium benzoate.explanation: A preservative; interpretation depends on formulation and exposure context.

potassium sorbate.title: Lower-priority preservative finding
potassium sorbate.explanation: A preservative used in many food and personal-care formulations.

phenoxyethanol.title: Context-dependent preservative finding
phenoxyethanol.explanation: A widely used preservative; the rule marks it for context review rather than declaring a product unsafe.

parfum.title: Fragrance-related review
parfum.explanation: Fragrance mixtures can matter for people with fragrance sensitivity; the exact composition may not be visible in a product ingredient list.

fragrance.title: Fragrance-related review
fragrance.explanation: The exact composition of a fragrance mixture may not be visible in the product ingredient declaration.

propylene glycol.title: Lower-priority ingredient finding
propylene glycol.explanation: Commonly used as a solvent and humectant; some individuals may experience irritation.

petrolatum.title: Context-dependent emollient finding
petrolatum.explanation: Used as an occlusive emollient. Suitability can depend on individual skin and formulation context.

bht.title: Review finding
bht.explanation: An antioxidant used in some formulations; this application flags it for evidence/context review.

butylated hydroxytoluene.title: Review finding
butylated hydroxytoluene.explanation: An antioxidant used in some formulations; this application flags it for evidence/context review.

sodium hydroxide.title: Context-dependent pH adjuster
sodium hydroxide.explanation: Often used in small amounts as a pH adjuster; interpretation depends on formulation and concentration.

tocopherol.title: Low concern in reference set
tocopherol.explanation: Vitamin E-related ingredient commonly used for antioxidant and conditioning roles.

tocopheryl acetate.title: Low concern in reference set
tocopheryl acetate.explanation: A vitamin E derivative commonly used for conditioning and antioxidant roles.

hyaluronic acid (sodium hyaluronate).title: Low concern in reference set
hyaluronic acid (sodium hyaluronate).explanation: Humectant used to attract and retain water in topical formulations.

salicylic acid.title: Context-dependent active
salicylic acid.explanation: An active ingredient with concentration and use-context considerations; this app does not assess personal suitability.

retinol.title: Context-dependent active
retinol.explanation: A biologically active cosmetic ingredient that may require careful use depending on context.

paracetamol.title: Medicine ingredient for label review
paracetamol.explanation: This is an active medicine ingredient. This application does not make treatment or dose decisions.

acetaminophen.title: Medicine ingredient for label review
acetaminophen.explanation: This is an active medicine ingredient. This application does not make treatment or dose decisions.

panthenol.title: Low concern in reference set
panthenol.explanation: Pro-vitamin B5 humectant used to attract moisture and support skin conditioning.

citric acid.title: Context-dependent pH regulator
citric acid.explanation: Alpha-hydroxy acid used in low concentrations as a pH adjuster and chelating aid; high concentrations may increase skin sensitivity.

xanthan gum.title: Low concern in reference set
xanthan gum.explanation: Polysaccharide gum produced by bacterial fermentation, widely used as a rheology modifier and thickener in cosmetics and food.

butylene glycol.title: Low concern in reference set
butylene glycol.explanation: Organic alcohol solvent and humectant used to dissolve ingredients and improve formula texture.

ceramide np.title: Low concern in reference set
ceramide np.explanation: Identical to lipids naturally found in human stratum corneum, used to support skin barrier integrity and hydration.

allantoin.title: Low concern in reference set
allantoin.explanation: Skin-soothing compound used to protect against irritation and support skin conditioning.

source.name: FDA OTC Skin Protectant Monograph / CIR

zinc oxide.title: Mineral active with use-context considerations
zinc oxide.explanation: Mineral physical sunscreen filter and skin protectant; topical non-nano forms have a strong safety profile while inhalation context (aerosols) requires precaution.

sugar.title: Nutrition-related review
sugar.explanation: Sugar is a dietary ingredient and its nutritional significance depends on total intake and serving context.

corn syrup.title: Nutrition-related review
corn syrup.explanation: A sweetener; dietary interpretation depends on the whole food and serving size.

salt.title: Nutrition-related review
salt.explanation: Salt contributes sodium; dietary relevance depends on the amount and overall diet.

whole grain oats.title: Ingredient identified
whole grain oats.explanation: A cereal grain ingredient; the app displays product data rather than making an individualized nutrition judgment.

natural flavour.title: Exact composition not specified
natural flavour.explanation: The label term can represent a mixture whose detailed composition is not provided here.

vitamin e.title: Ingredient identified
vitamin e.explanation: Vitamin E-related nutrient/ingredient; exact form matters.

folic acid.title: Ingredient identified
folic acid.explanation: A B-vitamin form commonly added for fortification.

paracetamol.explanation: This is a drug active ingredient. This app summarizes available label/reference data and does not assess personal suitability.
